summary: BytePlus's ModelArk Free-Token Campaign grants a free-token resource package per eligible model — the terms cite 500,000 tokens per model as an example, with the actual amount shown on the Model Activation page. Eligibility requires completing BytePlus account registration and submitting enterprise information; the package is redeemable once per account and may carry a validity period visible in the Billing Center. Packages offset post-paid token consumption in the ModelArk Playground or after model-service activation. Without formal activation, Playground access to that model stops when its package is exhausted. With formal activation, subsequent usage, including Playground use, is billable under the service agreement.
claim_steps: Register a BytePlus account and submit the required enterprise information.
Check ModelArk's Model Activation page for each model's actual quota (500,000 is only an example) and Billing Center for its validity period.

Use the package in Playground or formally activate model service. Without activation, Playground access stops at package exhaustion. With activation, subsequent usage, including Playground use, is billed post-paid under the service agreement.

social_proof.title: Terms and Conditions for Free-Token Campaign — BytePlus ModelArk
social_proof.text: Participants ... may be eligible to receive a free-token resource package ... for each eligible model ... with a value of 500,000 (Five Hundred Thousand) tokens per Model or such other amount of tokens as BytePlus may provide. Eligibility requires the completion of BytePlus account registration and enterprise information submission.

social_proof.title: ModelArk — service activation and paid continuation
social_proof.text: Following activation of a Model service, upon exhaustion of the Free-Token Package for such Model, BytePlus shall charge you for all subsequent use of such Model pursuant to the agreement signed with you, including usage within the Playground. In the absence of formal service activation, once the Free-Token Package for any Model is exhausted, access to such Model in the Playground shall be discontinued.
